body:
SCE Core can now run an operator-pinned Studious replay job, independently verify its trial receipt and show scoped results in Desktop. ROADMAP PR-020 and PR-021 are combined into one implementation package across their existing repository owners.

Companion market owner: [Studious PR #565](https://github.com/BobIvans/studious-pancake/pull/565), pinned to `905976ebd3046121728161d42f2e781c01f53e10`.

- Adds a registered Core job with strict reviewed profiles, immutable request intent, fixed argv, existing cancellation/lease/process handling and explicit orphan receipt reconciliation.
- Separates process exit, campaign outcome and qualification. Partial/empty campaigns, drift, changed artifacts and unknown outcomes cannot establish qualification.
- Adds scoped read-only research pages to Native/Desktop with complete pagination and snapshot fencing.
- Integrates main's PR014+015 Desktop/context installer and PR018+019 campaign runtime. Preserves Python/JS groups and history/delta/scan controls. Both the Native sibling layout and the actual versioned Desktop installer include and exercise the research modules.
- Preserves all 1,133 exact source criteria and all 47 capability IDs. Claim tables use the existing SQLite owner; exact scope, stale/conflicting evidence and DEFERRED remain visible. Hashes/replay facts cannot close arbitrary semantic criteria.
- Adds a frozen all-started-attempt metrics evaluator, a reproducible linked replay driver and exact-owner Ubuntu/Windows CI.
- Retains uppercase Windows SYSTEMROOT in isolated child environments while excluding credentials. CI checks out LF bytes before isolating Git configuration; source drift checks remain mandatory.

Validation: 457 Core tests, 37 Desktop tests (35 passed, two display-dependent local skips), 168 Node bridge/extension tests and eight qualification adapter tests passed. Studious has 182 selected domain and 28 release tests plus quality/release gates. The actual two-owner path completed five packs twice: 470 records, 460 handler calls, 450 useful domain evaluations and five identical repeat pairs. Both installed transports and owned-file verification passed. All six GitHub CI checks passed on the exact SCE head, including full Core, Desktop/context and linked replay on Ubuntu and Windows. All 28 Studious owner CI checks passed.

All 1,133 broad criteria remain OPEN. This draft delivers a partial offline implementation. Real provider/PAPER acquisition, protocol/runtime evidence, actual holdout/sensitivity, installed Dell qualification, all-family corpus, usefulness baseline/ablations/ROI and applicable prerequisite/semantic evidence remain open. Every receipt has `qualified=false`, `release_authorized=false`, `live_enabled=false` and zero transactions.

Owner map, limitations and commands: `docs/automation/pr020-021/README_RU.md` and `CAPABILITY_MAPPING.json`. Both repository PRs remain draft and are not merged.
